notes.title: Patch Note 1.0.2 is online
notes.notes: [h2]Patch Note 1.0.2[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Track Quest[/b][/h3][p]A new feature is coming to Magic Soldier![/p][p]You asked us to be able to pin quests? We did it![/p][p]You asked us to have a more intuitive quest tracker? We did it![/p][p]In the next update, a new feature will be coming, and it will please new players (and perhaps even veterans!)[/p][p][b]You will now have access to Quest Tracker, which will display an arrow below your character, indicating the shortest path (in theory!) to reach your objective.[/b][/p][p]Some details about this system:[/p][p]- Some tasks will **intentionally** not be tracked.[/p][p]- The system does not take walls into account! If the arrow tells you to go straight, but a forest or a wall appears in front of you, be smart and go around it ;)[/p][p]The arrow will change color depending on the quest tracked.[/p][p]We are convinced that this addition will help retain many more players during their first two hours of play.[/p][p]I give you little footage on how work this system.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/75cb98c4274fe7bee706ac756abb28617a7bd4f4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of new players, [b]we have decided to rework the tutorial[/b] to make it more epic, more engaging, and more comprehensive.[/p][p][/p][p]I won't spoil anything for those who want to repeat the tutorial, but I'll leave you with a visual :)[/p][p][b]We will also be adding a tutorial for:[/b][/p][p][b]Crafting[/b][/p][p][b]The Battlepass[/b][/p][p][b]Daily quests + localization[/b][/p][p][b]How the title system, bestiary, etc. work[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]HUD Improvements[/b][/h3][p]You will now be able to directly view your karma, as well as your experience and profession level, directly from the character window.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Selling in shops[/b][/h3][p]A new button has appeared on each NPC offering to buy or sell. This will allow you to directly switch between buy/sell mode at the merchant, allowing you to also see all the items they accept, as well as their selling prices.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quest icons have been revamped.[/b][/h3][p]I mentioned arrow colors just before.[/p][p]It will therefore match the new color code for quests above the character.[/p][p]I'll let you see the visuals for the icons and arrows.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469210/329665f90d12ee37c1ba45bddb9498fe4ac4a5a2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Work Faster, Not Harder![/b][/h3][p]A new tab appears in the character window. It is currently disabled and will be available later.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bugfix[/b][/h3][p]- A bug related to crafting (impossible to exit crafting if the inventory is full) has been fixed.[/p][p]- Bags in the hotbar now open the correct bag.[/p][p]- Several small bugs have been fixed.[/p]

notes.title: Magic Soldier - Breath of Reneval - Free to play release
notes.notes:
🌬️ Patch 1.0 – Breath of Renewal

The most ambitious update in Magic Soldier history is here.

⚔️ GAMEPLAY & SYSTEMS
🔓 Free to Play: The game is now 100% free for everyone.
🏹 Ranged Combat Rework:
Projectiles now automatically home in on your target.
Your character freezes briefly after attacking (based on attack speed).
🧙 Enchanting Rework:
New visual animations.
Fully redesigned UI for clarity and immersion.
🧼 Item Deletion: Permanently delete unwanted items with confirmation.
🧪 Persist on Death Effects: Some effects (like EXP potions) now remain after dying.
🧠 Major Fixes:
Monster respawn bugs → fixed
TAB targeting bug → fixed
New red flash when taking damage → added
😊 Character:
Max character 4 → 8

🎟️ BATTLEPASS
Access it from the top-left corner of the game menu.
50 levels of rewards: cosmetics, titles, items, and more.
100% Free for all players.
Earn Battlepass XP by daily quest (craft, battle, and more soon !).

Progression Modes:

🔁 Equal: XP is shared between all active passes.
📌 Priority: XP goes to one pass at a time, in order.
🪄 Simultaneous: All active passes get full XP.

⚠️ Known Bug: You can currently claim rewards with a full inventory — items may be lost. A fix is coming soon.

🛡️ ITEMS & INVENTORY
💎 Moonstone:
Adds 2 death protection charges to any equipped item.
One charge is consumed per death to prevent item loss.
📦 Magic Coin Balance now appears in your inventory (reopen to refresh).
📈 Stat cap increased: from 999 ➜ 1500.
💰 ECONOMY & SHOP
🛍️ In-Game Shop Integration: Accessible from anywhere, no more NPCs.
📉 Magic Coin Conversion:
Old rate: 1 MC = 1
New rate: 1 old MC ≈ 0.625 new MC
All old balances have been converted. Item prices adjusted.
📦 Shop prices updated to match the new economy.
💬 Discord Magic Coins:
Before: 1 MC every 30 seconds
Now: 1 MC every 1 hour

💵 New MC Packages:

€4.99 → 250 MC
€9.99 → 550 MC (+50 bonus)
€14.99 → 900 MC (+150 bonus)
€24.99 → 1500 MC (+300 bonus)
€49.99 → 3200 MC (+700 bonus)
📆 DAILY QUESTS
🗓️ New profession and hunting dailies available.
🔁 Reset daily at 6 PM (server time).
🪙 Earn Daily Coins for a rotating monthly reward shop.
👑 INTERFACE & QUALITY OF LIFE
🖥️ Full UI redesign — clean, retro-modern, and responsive.
🕒 New HUD info:
Local Time
Server Time
Current Magic Coin Balance
🗺️ NEW CONTENT
🌒 New Zone: Noxilbane (Level 95+)
📚 Bestiary: View stats, drops and level (Character window)
🏷️ Titles: 60 unlockable titles with rarities ⚪ 🟢 🔵 🟣 🟡 🔴 🟠
🎁 New Items:
Noxilbane Relic (Lv. 90 – DEF, MDEF, Speed)
Gibli Pet (Lv. 99)
Moonstone, Daily Coins, Auras, Skins, and more
Next time, each comestic will had video on descriptions for preview
🤝 REFERRAL SYSTEM
🎯 Referral Link: https://playmagicsoldier.com/en/referral
Also accessible via My Account → Referral
Unlock up to 5 reward tiers.
Referees also receive a welcome bonus.
📢 FROM THE DEVELOPERS

"There are just two of us, but thousands of you dreaming with us."

Coming soon: Account-wide bank, class quests, elemental story arcs, a new class, gear balance, live events, and more secret systems 👀
Thank you for your feedback, passion, and support — you shape the game as much as we do.
🎟️ TOTHEMOON 🎟️

⚔️ Onward, Soldier. The magic calls.

notes.title: ✨ Development Update
notes.notes:
✅ It’s done! The changes have been implemented and everything’s running smoothly. Huge thanks for your patience and feedback 🫶 Here’s what’s been fixed and improved:

🛠️ Spell Latency
We finally identified the cause of the spell latency bug. The more enhanced gear a player wore, the worse the lag became — all due to a miscalculation in the code. That issue is now fully fixed, leading to smoother, more responsive combat! 🧙‍♀️✨

♻️ Energy Reset Bug
The bug that sometimes prevented energy points from resetting has also been resolved. You can now dive back into your instances without any trouble! (/reset) ⚡🌀

🖥️ New Server
We tackled a major server architecture issue, allowing us to migrate to a much more powerful machine. The result? Better performance, increased stability, and more room for all the wild ideas we’re cooking up. Dreaming big, as always 🚀

Thanks again for your amazing support 💖
Stay tuned — more updates are just around the corner!

notes.title: ✨ Dev Update - Sunday, April 13th from 6 PM to 10 PM (UTC+2)
notes.notes:
🛠️ Spell Latency Issue
We’ve identified the cause of the annoying lag on some spells. Turns out, the more upgraded gear you had equipped, the worse the latency became — all due to a miscalculation in the code. This will be fully fixed in the next update, bringing smoother and more responsive combat! 🧙‍♂️⚔️

♻️ Energy Reset Bug
Another long-standing issue: energy points sometimes wouldn’t reset properly. We’ve tracked it down and fixed it — and this fix will be part of the upcoming patch. Get ready to fight in instance freely again! 🔄⚡

🖥️ New Server
We’ve resolved a major backend architecture issue, which means we’re now ready to move the game to a much more powerful server. You can expect better stability, faster response times, and room for expansion. We’re thinking big! 🚀

Thanks for being such an amazing community — your feedback and support keep us going strong ❤️
Stay tuned, the update is just around the corner!
